Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Legal review ownership & turnaround times

Thanks again for the call this morning — good alignment on scope and the MAP milestones. Attached is the draft MAP (Novacorp_MAP_v0.1.xlsx) and the current Redwood MSA that we expect to use as the starting point (Redwood_MSA_v3_redline.docx).

High-level ask: please confirm who on Novacorp legal will own redlines/edits and what turnaround time we should expect. To avoid churn, we'd like to agree on ownership and TAT for the MSA/DPA/SLA redlines so the MAP milestone can be updated and the project timeline stays on track.

Proposed milestones (please confirm or revise):
- Legal redlines (MSA/DPA/SLA) from Novacorp -> due: 3 business days from receipt (target: 2026-11-23) — Owner: Novacorp Legal
- Redwood acknowledgement + point-by-point intake -> due: 1 business day after receipt (target: 2026-11-24) — Owner: Redwood Legal (cc Marissa)
- Substantive Redwood responses / counter-redlines -> due: 2 business days after receipt of initial redlines (target: 2026-11-26) — Owner: Redwood Legal
- Finalize negotiated MSA & sign SOW -> Target close date: 2026-12-02 — Owner: Sales + Legal

Dependencies noted: SOC 2 evidence review (security team), procurement PO approval, and final scope confirmation in SOW. If Novacorp needs a longer legal queue, let us know — we can adjust MAP windows.

Next steps: please reply with (1) legal owner contact for redlines, (2) preferred redline method (track-changes in doc vs comment-by-comment), and (3) acceptable TAT. Once confirmed I'll update the MAP and log milestones in HubSpot (link below).

Attachments: Novacorp_MAP_v0.1.xlsx, Redwood_MSA_v3_redline.docx

Thanks, Karthik — appreciate the recap and the MAP draft.

Quick answers: Tom Hsu (copied) will own Novacorp side of the redlines for the MSA/DPA/SLA. Our standard is to redline directly in the document (we use tracked changes) and return it to you. That said, our internal calendar is tight this week; realistically we can turn around initial redlines in 4 business days (by 2026-11-24) rather than 3.

Two questions from our side: (1) Will Redwood accept direct track-changes in the MSA doc, or do you prefer comment-by-comment? (2) Who will be the single point of contact on the Redwood legal side for intake and consolidation of our redlines?

We can target the 2026-12-02 close but if the redline loop goes long we may need to push.

Regards,

Thanks Ava — appreciate the heads up on the queue. To be explicit and reduce back-and-forth, here's what Redwood proposes so we can lock the MAP milestone windows: 

Proposed ownership & TAT (Redwood):
- Novacorp Legal (Owner: Tom Hsu) 
  - Action: Return tracked-changes copy of MSA/DPA/SLA to Marissa (marissa_cole@redwood.com)
  - TAT: initial redline submission within 4 business days of receipt (target: 2026-11-24)
- Redwood Legal (Owner: Marissa Cole)
  - Action: Acknowledge receipt within 1 business day; consolidate and produce point-by-point response or counter-redline within 2 business days of receipt (target: acknowledgement 2026-11-25; substantive response 2026-11-26)
- Sales (Owner: Karthik Iyer)
  - Action: Maintain MAP spreadsheet, track milestones in HubSpot, surface open legal items to procurement and executive sponsor if escalations required

If Novacorp prefers comment-by-comment instead of track-changes we can accept either; track-changes tends to be faster for us but we will respect your process. For heavy redlines we propose an optional 30-minute joint legal sync (Marissa + Tom) to triage high-impact clauses (e.g., data residency, indemnity, SLA credits).

Updated milestones (accept or propose edits):
- 2026-11-18: MAP v0.1 shared (done)
- 2026-11-24: Novacorp initial redlines (Owner: Novacorp Legal)
- 2026-11-25: Redwood acknowledgement + intake (Owner: Redwood Legal)
- 2026-11-26: Redwood substantive response / counter (Owner: Redwood Legal)
- 2026-11-30: Final legal alignment
- 2026-12-02: Target signature & SOW sign-off (Owner: Sales + Legal)

I've attached the current MAP and MSA for convenience. I'll update the HubSpot deal and flag the MAP milestone dates accordingly. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345

Please confirm: (1) Tom as Novacorp owner, (2) acceptance of the 4/1/2 business-day cadence, and (3) whether you want the joint legal triage call if substantive redlines appear.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this smoothly.
